d: Chill out in Angela's upstairs addition, where a contractor's neglect has resulted in an ice-cold, unlivable bedroom. Tally up the issues with Mike after he tears open the ceiling, adds crucial insulation, and discovers even more cans of worms.

Go full tilt on a repair to Jim and Helen's kitchen addition, where the floor has buckled after a single party. Follow Mike downstairs to secure the joists and add braces, and reflect on the importance of structural integrity as well as design.
Aiden dreams up a mashup birthday cake: half trampoline, half soccer field! Adjoa and Damion bounce into action for this high-flying challenge.

Amateur comedian, corporate defector, and ex-fashion designer face off in a mystery ingredient round using pizza toppings to make donuts. The final two compete in a New York City-themed Donut Showdown for $10,000.

Work out the options with pro bodybuilders Kelly and Michael, who want a lakefront nest where they can train and entertain. Consider a mod build with a glass wine cellar, a vast home with a putting green, and a unique oasis with a pop-up fireplace.

Explore options with Leanne as she searches for a new forever home for her family. She's ready to leave the hustle, bustle, and nosy neighbours of her city rental behind, trading it all for peace, privacy, and room to grow in the country.

With the old cabin demolished, tensions mount as Danielle tries to manage her sister and brother-in-law's very different aesthetics. Watch as she tries to bridge the gap between a warm, cozy man cave and an ultra-clean, modern design.
Collectors travel great distances to meet and practice with Major League Baseball team, the Pittsburgh Pirates.

Watch as Bam Bam and Marty randomly head into a yard sale, only to be greeted by the owner and a rifle. The boys also discover a pop culture bonanza and Marty may have just bought his biggest bounty of the season.

Head out to Cass' beach club, where 11 vacation homes encircle an in-ground pool. Join Paul and the crew as they tackle an ambitious build: twin lounges with pergolas, a chill sun deck, and fire features that will take parties well into the evening.

Dial up the drama when Paul guts David and Laura's kitchen, tweaking the layout and adding a splashy backsplash that'll be the backdrop to their entertaining dreams. Then check out Thea's vanity, which is made-to-measure for a zombie lover like her.
Alex dreams of a giant donut birthday cake! Umie and Adjoa battle to turn her sweet obsession into a gravity-defying dessert.
Chloe, a synchronised swimmer, wants a mermaid-themed aquatic cake. Jane and Damion dive into her detailed, splashy design.
Soccer star Ella imagines an enormous edible soccer ball for her birthday. Trish and Adjoa kick off a sweet competition to impress the birthday girl.
Derek, Rachelle, and Nate must make donuts with a “Love” theme and impress the judges to take home the $10,000 grand prize.
Jasmine, Martin, and Ambergré face off in a mystery round with jelly beans for a chance to compete in a Vegas-themed Donut Showdown. The last two standing compete for $10,000.
A diner gal, executive chef, and vintage vixen battle it out with tomato juice as the mystery ingredient for a chance to compete in a Zombie-themed Donut Showdown and win $10,000.

Check out the smelly, icy kitchen addition that's worrying Neil and Michelle in their first house. Examine its maxed-out electrical circuits with Mike, who chases down the cause of this room's issues so the crew can turn it into a warm, safe space.

Get shaken when Mike and MJ discover a new budget- and schedule-killing issue with the Country House barn. See what designer Sarah Richardson says about the Holmes duo's flooring debate, then celebrate a new beginning when MJ and Lisa tie the knot.

Drill down on Jeremy's kitchen reno with Mike and find nothing but cosmetic fixes on top of a host of old problems. Watch the crew take it back to the studs, upgrade the underlying systems, and deliver a gorgeous space built on solid foundations.

Look at the tech going into the home, including solar panels, geothermal cooling, and a stormwater purification system. Catch up with Gloria, who's happy her beloved cacti are part of the landscaping, and stand back as crew issues boil over…again.

Rally around a teacher injured in a hit and run and see Mike's crew band together to make his backyard deck accessible while he learns to walk again. Explore their custom healing oasis and enjoy a knockout visit with boxing legend George Chuvalo.

Welcome order and a bit of Pacific flair to Jeremy and Tabitha's family room when Paul adds custom sliding screens and tons of storage. Then uncork some magic as Allen and Christina's vintage barn doors become a chic wine cabinet in Paul's workshop.

Tour Terri's reimagined dream kitchen, complete with a made-to-order breakfast bar and entertaining area that's worth the 20-year wait. Then check out Kimberly's mid-century modern media centre, which Paul perfectly fits around her flat-screen TV.

Welcome the shade in a cool gazebo built entirely from found wood. Join Colin as he harvests his own logs in a nearby forest to build a brilliant, low-cost alternative to an aluminum pop-up canopy on John's sun-kissed property.

Get to know contractor Tom Stead as he pitches in to help Colin construct a massive dock made entirely of steel. Review the plans for this behemoth of a project, which needs to be stable and sturdy enough to support a beautiful boathouse.
In this episode Andrew is in Washington, D.C. where the finds are truly unique… including a rare Hot Wheels collection.
In this episode Andrew is in Los Angeles and the city of angels definitely delivers… starting with a warehouse filled with thousands of skateboards!

It's a world of adventure for Bam Bam and Marty as they experience a taste of Germany and head back to school where they get a lesson in negotiating. Later, follow the backroads out to a sea of abandoned boats where surprising deals are made.

Weigh the options with empty nesters Glen and Sherry, who would like a guest-ready lakefront property with income potential. Check out a sporty island retreat, a mod home with a reversed floor plan, and a classic property with granite landscaping.

Go for broke with Chantal and Keith, who haven't found their dream lake house…even after 300 viewings! Explore a castle-like estate with an indoor pool, a sprawling spread with a six-car garage, and an Art Deco-inspired home with a secret garden.

Make a splash with passionate sailors Joey and Tatiana, who are searching for a party-ready hideaway with a luxe boathouse. Take a look at an island home with its own spa, a house with wraparound lake views, and an A-frame with a gourmet kitchen.

Meet Deb and Wolfe, long-time friends who became late-in-life lovebirds. Find out whether a unique timber house with a luxe kitchen, a modern home with a kid-friendly loft, or a resort-style property is the ideal retreat for their blended family.

Team up with Amanda and Shawn, two best friends and colleagues who want a vacation property they can comfortably share. Check out a '60s dream with a lava rock fireplace, a multi-level house made for entertaining, and a soaring, secluded chalet.

Survey all the tasty options with chef Phil and his new fiancé Michelle, who are hunting for a lakeside home where they can entertain in style. Tour a contemporary new build on a canal, a rustic log cabin, and an A-frame with a pub-like atmosphere.

Investigate a hidden reno that threatens family health and safety. Join Mike as he assesses Kris and Dave's basement playroom, where a closed-in cold cellar offers the perfect breeding ground for mould. Then see the crew send this fungus packing.

Size up a structural snag that could jack up the cost of Mike's open concept vision for the Suburban House. Deal with a major deck issue at the Country House before MJ fields another curveball from Mike that could severely impact their business plan.

Check out the good part of Lee and Bailey's new townhouse (a fridge that makes ice cubes) and the bad part (a frigid attic that makes snow cones). Tag along as Mike gets to the bottom of the problem, which builder Band-Aid fixes haven't solved.

Check out Dave and Melanie's $38,000 bust: a kitchen addition and deck that failed a city inspection. See what Mike and his team propose to redeem this reno after the stucco starts to crumble and the contractor stops returning the couple's calls.

Rush to the rescue of the Alpha Omicron Pi sorority house, where a leak is putting the kibosh on the Greek-life good times. Join Mike as he supervises the installation of a brand new flat roof, complete with a safe, party-ready rooftop deck.

Take on an emotional job with the Holmes crew, who help a high school shop teacher and his students finish a basement reno for a classmate's grieving parents. Listen as Mike delivers his best lessons on construction, healing, and working together.

Marty and Bam Bam milk the deals when they visit a dairy collector with thousands of milk bottles. Ride along as they look for smoked meats and smokin' deals by randomly pulling off of the backroads in search of more treasure.

Consider all the options with Sandi and Jeff, who show up to their first planning session with nothing more than an open mind. Watch Lynzie take creative licence as she designs an outside-the-box blowout featuring an edgy colour scheme.

Kick back as Kevin and Nancy describe the relaxing lake-house vibe they want at their wedding…in the city. Feel the heat as Lynzie's team performs a crazy room flip and transforms an industrial space into a rustic country escape made for romance.

Celebrate the virtues of a beloved building material and learn why wood is the gold standard for many architects. Check out how this natural resource takes a Japanese-inspired home, a restored lodge, and a timber-clad cabin to the next level.

Ponder the challenges of successfully embedding a building into its surroundings. Marvel at a mansion constructed more than 100 years ago, a 20-year-old modern design that's stood the test of time, and a contemporary barn with a surprising view.

Meet three rental owners who share their passions with their guests. See David's tribute to his great-grandfather's artistry, get a next-level dining experience from world-class chef Grant, and experience tiny living on Brittney's family fruit farm.

With the old cabin demolished, tensions mount as Danielle tries to manage her sister and brother-in-law's very different aesthetics. Watch as she tries to bridge the gap between a warm, cozy man cave and an ultra-clean, modern design.

Admire the gorgeous open concept reno that Rick and Deirdre flipped over right before their home inspection flopped. Gasp as Mike uncovers evidence of shoddy work done by house flippers and see how Damon and the crew turn this home around.

Navigate a torrent of muck at the River House and follow the crew as they rush to finish the home ahead of winter's arrival. Look inside the next property the Holmeses will take on before Mike throws a monkey wrench into their reno plan and budget.

Navigate through the rubble of two terrible unfinished renos that left Kathleen without a crucial accessible bathroom in her high-rise apartment. Watch as the Holmes team transforms this concrete shell into a welcoming, wheelchair-friendly space.

Brace for happy tears as dozens of people race an oncoming storm to put the final touches on Gloria's house, inside and out. Hustle as lights, paint, and appliances go in and Gloria finally comes home, just as Hurricane Gustav makes landfall.

Say hello to red tape, courtesy of Rocco and Stephanie's title insurance company and the government. Learn why the city approved the couple's disastrous DIY renos on their century home and see how Mike cuts through the bureaucracy to make it right.

Kick up your heels in Tim and Terri Anne's new mud room, where Paul incorporates a hidden laundry corner and lockers that reflect the couple's love of travel. Then watch him transform a derelict piano into a cocktail bar in Karen's country home.

Enjoy the peace as Paul delivers a bedroom and ensuite packed with custom builds that give parents David and Andrea the privacy (and storage) they need. Then marvel at Paul's compact coffee table that will do double duty in Claudia's snug apartment.

Say goodbye to Cheryl and Andrew's tumbledown cedar deck, and hello to Paul's low-maintenance, high-style replacement. Check out the amazing add-ons, including a mammoth hot tub and heated walkway, that make this project stone cold stylish.

Get tips for creating truly private outdoor spaces when Paul fulfills Selmin and Yasmin's request to build a relaxing deck where Yasmin can enjoy the outdoors without wearing her hijab. See the amazing two-tier result that's ready for any weather.
Two shoe fanatics go head-to-head in tests of knowledge and skill.
See a showdown of "brewerania" and a beer tasting challenge to determine how well beer contestants know their beer.

The guys follow one of the most amazing stories of ‘stuff' they've ever heard to discover 8 full trailers packed with goods. See deal making in action as Marty and Bam Bam make unique finds, from a vintage Italian motorcycle to a Model A Ford.

Find balance with Cathy and Mark, two recent retirees who need space to focus on their art and care for Cathy's brother, who lives with them. Look inside a resort-like retreat, a home with a unique fireplace, and an angular house with a mega-kitchen.

Plunge into the hunt for a waterfront property where Bruce and Darka can spend their retirement pursuing their passion for sports and for entertaining. Check out a scuba-friendly oasis, a sumptuous estate, and a modern new home with a rooftop pool.

Team up with single-mom BFFs Karem and Sarah, who are searching for a home they can invest in together. Look around a resort-style spread with five bedrooms, a roomy waterfront house with 22-foot ceilings, and a cozy family home with stunning views.

Upsize with Frances and Shawn, who need lots of elbow room for their four active sons. Wander around a rough-hewn house featuring a wall of windows, a rustic residence with a stunning stone fireplace, and a modern home clad in Japanese cedar.

Say goodbye to cramped condo living with Jeremy and Jonathan, who are craving waterfront vistas and wide open spaces. Peek inside a huge Cape Cod-style house, an isolated property made for hiking and climbing, and a new build with high-end finishes.

Uncover new surprises as Mike's team pinpoints the cause of a major pipe freeze-up in Mike and Tricia's main-floor laundry room. Go over an earlier home inspection that delivered high marks but missed crucial details, and see the crew make it right.

Soak up ensuite advice from designer Sarah Richardson at the Country House before the Holmeses show off cool tech that will make the Suburban House energy efficient. Then feel the pressure as MJ tries to surprise Mike by finishing the River House.

Sing the kitchen reno blues with Nancie and Woody, whose contractors left them with a cooking space that's nothing but one giant mistake. Join Mike, the Holmes team, and a surprise country-singing guest star as they tune up this family's galley.

Get that sinking feeling when Geoff and Lorraine show off their newly lowered basement, which is filling with moisture. Head down with Mike and the team, who install an interior weeping tile system and bring the unsafe electrical system up to code.

Hold tight as Donna and Paul show Mike their uninsulated roof, which is causing water damage, and 13 windows with sloppy capping that are letting in drafts. Welcome reno pro Jon Eakes, who lends a hand and helps bring comfort home for the long haul.

Feel the frustration when Gill and Julie discover that the $17,500 prototype wheelchair lift they had installed for their daughter, Maya, is a dud. Join Mike as he rethinks and redesigns this problematic addition to help give Maya more independence.

The team steers off the backroads and into the hands, and the collection, of the law. Then, the boys find themselves with a barbershop quartet of bounty. Hop into the van for a boisterous episode bristling with beards and mullets!

Discover the gaps in a home-inspection report that lulled Jennifer and Paul into a false sense of security. Join Mike's team as they give this couple a second opinion and get to work making their downtown character home as safe and sound as it looks.

Meet Natalie, who stepped in after an aneurysm and two strokes halted the reno her mother, Ingrid, spent her life savings on. Follow Mike as he redoes incorrect HVAC, low-grade plumbing, and more to create the dream home this duo needs for recovery.

Listen as Sarah Richardson talks turkey about tiles with MJ, who makes bold choices for the Country House bathrooms. Watch flooring installation kick into high gear and prepare to say goodbye to the River House, which only needs finishing touches.

Sympathize with Wayne and Gilda, whose $20K kitchen reno has ground to a halt after the contractor gutted the place and disappeared with nothing but lame excuses. Cheer as Mike's crew gets to work and makes the project right in just one week.

Inspect the three very leaky windows that four contractors haven't been able to fix for Rasema and her mum. Hit the roof with Mike and the crew as they tackle the problem from the top down, installing new windows and a water-diverting eavestrough.

Make an emergency house call to Fred and Sara's diminutive, historical two-storey with Mike and the crew. Learn how gaping holes in their seemingly solid home inspection have led to a high-stakes repair mission for Damon and the construction team.

Get a fresh start with Manuel, whose grief over his wife's death four years ago led him to seal off his bedroom and let the critters move in. Stand by as his son, Ben, helps Mike's team demolish this sad reminder and create a space for new memories.

Meet Gwyn and Andrew, self-confessed Mike Holmes junkies who thought they went the extra mile to ensure a smooth bathroom reno. Poke around with Mike, who nails down the biggest issues and helps them realize their dream without getting ripped off.
Addyson's galactic birthday cake features her in a spacesuit floating through the stars. Jane and Annie shoot for the stars with this out-of-this-world bake.

A second-generation donut maker, café owner, and executive chef compete with strawberry gelatin as the mystery ingredient. The final two must impress the judges in a 1950s-themed Donut Showdown for $10,000.

Bone up on the options with Chelsea and Spencer, who are in the market for a waterfront home that their pup, Henry, will approve of. Feast your eyes on a new build with a chef's kitchen, a Scandinavian-style log home, and a soaring, modern hideaway.

Get ready for another dust-up as Rob tries to find a cottage that will satisfy Sally, who wants something move-in ready, while also finding her husband a fixer-upper's dream. Luckily, they both want a place where they can relax with their family.

Join the hunt as the guys come across awesome deals on vintage military items and cool vintage signs. They also return to their arch nemesis, Gold Finger Ernie, and find a bounty worth a lot of bread.
